scope: Mechanical validation of the planning map; not terrain or build clearance

checks.detail: The SVG references the stable terminal c39d whole-world raster.
Map X increases right; map Z increases down; north is -Z.
Current catalog maxX=1300; proposed reservation minX=1500; 200-block catalog separation.
The proposed reservation is hatched and labeled NOT SURVEYED; the map makes no vacant-land claim.
Verified existing extent, proposed surface zones, underground projection, physical connector, and logical portal link use distinct patterns and line styles.
Ravensreach remains the accepted Old Town; Z02 is Gateway Approach and contains no duplicate 33-schematic town program.
Both surface stops, GA-J1, the branch study, and Z02-U1 remain within Z02 x=1550..1950, z=-600..0.
GA-S1 and GA-S2 each define two 48-block side platforms on the z=-250 passenger-rail study alignment.
Z02-U1 declares exactly eight track centerlines, eight assigned platforms, four paired future lines, and eight sealed north interfaces.
The provisional Y=72 to Y=48 descent reserves at least 145 horizontal blocks for a 24-block change, no steeper than average 1:6; final rail geometry remains survey-gated.
All eight north interfaces are sealed; initial links to PassageWay, Houston tunnels, SubTropolis, and Cheyenne are explicitly prohibited.
Headless Chromium rendered the whole-world, Z02 detail, and vertical SVGs at 2400x1500, 1800x1200, and 1600x1050 with local-file access enabled.

limitations: No fresh August 3 saved-world snapshot was taken.
No east-reserve terrain, ownership, entity, protected-feature, or world-border survey was performed.
No Z02 underground-cover, groundwater, ventilation, smoke-control, egress, structural, or geotechnical survey was performed.
No collision audit beyond the accepted durable feature union was performed.
No world edit, RCON operation, live route test, or portal activation was performed.
